reason: The v18 through v22 selector, batch-size, grouped-label, and alternate-provider experiments did not satisfy the locked exact-set floor. R79 replaces them with one complete primary classification followed by one candidate-aware completeness reviewer whose valid complete judgment is authoritative. This budget measures that exact production call path on the already-consumed 120-row development cohort and cannot approve release.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort; unchanged from the v18 all-locale probe

production_shape.primary: one complete primary call per batch of at most 20 posts
production_shape.review: one candidate-aware completeness-review call per batch of at most 10 post-brand packets
production_shape.selection: a valid reviewer classification replaces the primary judgment in full; no union, language selector, grouped booleans, consensus, or rare-label audit
production_shape.failure: a review row that remains invalid after its bounded repair leaves the post unpublished; it never publishes the primary as a fallback
production_shape.input_measurement: primary uses exact frozen source envelopes; review uses the exact frozen source envelopes plus complete adjudicated development classifications as representative primary proposals
production_shape.unexpected_logical_request_capacity: the transport budget permits 20 logical requests beyond the expected 18, shared by primary row fallbacks plus primary and review repair calls; it may stop before the runtime's separate 20-repair allowance is exhausted
production_shape.global_retry_capacity: each logical request may retry at most twice, while the stricter 58-attempt lane ceiling permits at most 20 transport retries in total after 38 distinct logical requests; the first exhausted cap stops the run
production_shape.budget_exhaustion_behavior: fail closed without a candidate; capacity is deliberately not sized for every primary row to fall back or every logical request to retry twice

decision_rule: Continue to the full consumed 500-row development assessment only if all 120 rows validate, overall and each-locale exact post-type sets are at least 0.70, overall exact product-label sets are at least 0.85 and each locale is at least 0.70, outcome accuracy is at least 0.90, context_missing precision and recall are at least 0.50 when supported, and every supported post/product label F1 meets its unchanged floor. Unsupported labels remain support gaps and cannot pass a release gate.
global_stop: The client reserves the current request's conservative input estimate, full output allowance, transport attempt, and maximum price before network transport. It refuses the first operation that would exceed any cap, including when primary fallbacks, repairs, or retries compete for the stricter global capacity. Cached successful responses replay without new reservations, and capacity cannot transfer to another cohort, provider, model, prompt, or lane.
